description.summary: an app's menus in the global menu bar
creates the menu object of an app

request.name: destroy

description.summary: the manager is no longer needed

request.description: The menu objects already created stay valid.

entry.name: already_has_menu
entry.summary: the client already has a menu object

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: the surface is not a surface of this client's window or popup

entry.name: context
entry.summary: a context menu at the pointer (or a pull-down below a control)

entry.name: pop_up
entry.summary: a pop-up button's menu, the selected item over the control

request.name: get_menu

description.summary: the menu object of this client

request.description: One per client: the menus belong to the app, not to one of its windows (the app updates them when its active window changes). The bar shows them while one of the client's windows, or the client itself as the windowless frontmost app, is in front.

request.name: get_popup_menu

description.summary: starts a context menu or a pop-up button's menu

request.description:
The shell draws the menu and the compositor places it and decides when it ends: the app only describes the rows (add_item, add_separator, add_section, begin_submenu, end_submenu), makes the menu visible with show, and learns the result with selected or dismissed (silica-os/silica-desktop#241).
The anchor is a rectangle in the coordinates of surface, in logical pixels: a 0 × 0 rectangle at the pointer for a context menu, the control's rectangle for a pop-up button. selected is the id of the item the pop-up button currently shows (0 for none), which the menu aligns over the control.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: the app has no menus any more

request.description: The bar goes back to the generic menus it shows for apps without a model.

entry.name: invalid_model
entry.summary: the model is not readable or not valid

request.name: set_model
request.description: The file holds the model from offset 0, size bytes long (a sealed memfd is the natural choice). The compositor reads it at once and closes the descriptor: the app can reuse or drop the file after the request. A file that cannot be read, a size of 0 or above max_model_size, invalid JSON or a model past the limits (32 menus, 4096 items, items at most 4 levels below a top-level menu, labels of 256 bytes) is the invalid_model error.

event.name: activated

description.summary: an item was chosen in the bar

event.description: The id of an item of the model, as the app sent it. The model may have changed since the bar showed it: an id the app no longer knows is ignored.

interface.name: silica_popup_menu_v1

description.summary: a context menu or a pop-up button's menu

interface.description:
A menu of rows built with requests, in document order, then shown. It is shown at most once and answered at most once: selected (the user chose an item) or dismissed (the compositor ended it: a press outside, a change of context, the surface going away, or a newer menu of the same client). Destroying the object ends the menu without an event.
Rows: an item has an id (non-zero, unique in the menu), a label, flags, an icon (a symbol name or an absolute path; empty for none) and an optional shortcut shown at the right (key name as in silica-menu-v1, modifiers a bit set); a section is a heading row; a submenu is begin_submenu, its rows, end_submenu. Limits: 1024 rows, 4 levels of submenu, 256 bytes for labels, icons and keys.

entry.name: invalid_state
entry.summary: a request in the wrong order, or after show

entry.name: invalid_row
entry.summary: a repeated or zero id, or text past the limits

entry.name: too_many_rows
entry.summary: more rows or levels than the limits

entry.name: mixed
entry.summary: a dash instead of the checkmark

request.name: destroy

description.summary: the menu is not needed any more

request.description: A menu that is open ends without selected or dismissed.

request.name: show
request.description: Ends the description. A menu with no item is not shown and gets dismissed at once; a submenu left open is an invalid_state error.

event.name: selected
event.description: Sent once, after the shell's blink of the chosen row. The menu is over.

event.name: dismissed

description.summary: the menu ended without a choice

event.description: Sent once. The menu is over; the object stays valid until destroyed.
